svg.title: Midnight Garden — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: Large black cat, moon, layered hills, and jewel-like flowers. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
svg.metadata: {"slug": "midnight-garden", "title": "Midnight Garden", "desc": "Large black cat, moon, layered hills, and jewel-like flowers.", "tags": ["Animal", "Floral", "Cozy", "OurSpace Original"], "palette": [{"hex": "#F3D7B5", "name": "Cream"}, {"hex": "#E85D75", "name": "Coral"}, {"hex": "#F28C8C", "name": "Sage"}, {"hex": "#F4B942", "name": "Pine"}, {"hex": "#7EBC89", "name": "Ochre"}, {"hex": "#3D7A5C", "name": "Clay"}, {"hex": "#5D4A8C", "name": "Mist"}, {"hex": "#9B6BC6", "name": "Blush"}, {"hex": "#3F8FC7", "name": "Espresso"}, {"hex": "#E978A9", "name": "Sand"}, {"hex": "#8ECBC0", "name": "Sea Glass"}, {"hex": "#D05F44", "name": "Ember"}, {"hex": "#F6E5D8", "name": "Porcelain"}, {"hex": "#557A45", "name": "Moss"}, {"hex": "#B83B5E", "name": "Berry"}, {"hex": "#E7A43A", "name": "Marigold"}, {"hex": "#6A4C93", "name": "Violet"}, {"hex": "#2E7D75", "name": "Lagoon"}, {"hex": "#F0C987", "name": "Honey"}, {"hex": "#A05C7B", "name": "Mauve"}, {"hex": "#6BAE75", "name": "Leaf"}, {"hex": "#D94F70", "name": "Poppy"}, {"hex": "#4F6B9C", "name": "Sky"}], "complexity": "Detailed"}
